test_title: PYST 9: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row I – E, F, G and H are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row II – U, V, W and X are seated and all of them are facing north.

G sits exactly opposite U, who sits second from the right end of their row. F sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite X. E sits between F and G and is exactly opposite V.

Who sits at the extreme left end of the row of people facing South?
solution:
**Given:**

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In Row (I) – E, F, G and H are seated and all of them are facing south.

In Row (II) – U, V, W and X are seated and all of them are facing north.

The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. G sits exactly opposite U, who sits second from the right end of their row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8866ff14ae4288746daac35a11a0b956ce3c27851226b78e177acf4962f86adc.png] 

2. F sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/050d13f9ea8a51d397a1059aba81b7cc3ee315e570761028c895657ce448d6d5.png] 

3. E sits between F and G and is exactly opposite V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e49936a5a4689ee75a3f72f6a946e7df4d202c5f5cbda9d0fb86ffdf2dfa0c9.png] 

Here, **'H'** sits at the extreme left end of the row of people facing South.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
